name: hz0a_300m
attention_rule: 0-indexed layers listed in attention_layer_indices are causal attention blocks; all others are GDN-2 recurrent blocks
normalization: RMSNorm pre-norm on mixer/attention and MLP sublayers, final RMSNorm before tied LM head
residual_order: pre-norm -> mixer/attention -> residual add -> pre-norm -> SwiGLU MLP -> residual add
state_layout: per recurrent layer state tensor is [batch, heads, d_v, d_k]

precision_policy.training_target: bf16 activations with fp32 master weights, optimizer state, reductions, and gradient accumulation
precision_policy.state_accumulation: fp32 for reference and early PMetal correctness phases

tokenizer_policy.current_contract: model architecture assumes a rebuilt tokenizer with vocab_size fixed at 24576

backend_targets.inference: fused Metal after correctness is established
